_about: Stated facts that decide a PAC's group where the FEC fields and the IRS master file don't (scripts/refresh/lib/sponsors.mjs). Each is a fact about the sponsor, checkable by anyone. Added 2026-10-11 for the final candidate; the owner reviews the list.
